# E0132: a schema uses a comprehension

A schema's fields are known without evaluating any data. A comprehension makes
them depend on evaluation, and then no check can describe the schema: not
compatibility between versions, not whether a lens produces every field.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				if true {
					b: int
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0132]: schema 0.0 uses a comprehension
 --> lineage.cue:7:5
  |
7 |                 if true {
  |                 ^^
  |
  = note: a schema's fields must be known without evaluating data: no check can describe a schema whose fields depend on evaluation
  = help: write the fields the comprehension would produce
```
